patch.value: Adopt pm-cli 2026.7.26 typed authoring contracts and move registry tests onto the real activation harness

Remove the forced-any defineExtension shim in favour of a locally declared identity helper constrained by the SDK ExtensionModule contract, type activate with the real ExtensionApi, and migrate the three hand-built api doubles in tests/registry.test.ts to activateExtensionForTest and runRegisteredCommandForTest with the capability grant read from manifest.json.

No any casts remain in the extension definition path; No hand-built api doubles remain in tests; Dependency on @unbrained/pm-cli stays type-only at runtime; typecheck clean, full suite passes, and pm presets --list works in a real installed workspace

Replaced the any-cast defineExtension shim with a locally declared identity helper constrained by ExtensionModule, typed activate with the real ExtensionApi, and migrated the three registry test doubles onto activateExtensionForTest/runRegisteredCommandForTest.
No any in the definition path, tests exercising the real activation contract under manifest capability governance, and no new runtime module edge.
typecheck clean; 46/46 tests pass; functional install into a throwaway workspace confirmed pm presets --list renders the preset catalog.
